#Lollyplot Plot

```{r}

#Data from EJSCREEN

df <- tibble(
  variable = rep(c("% POC", "Life Exp", "Low Inc", "Diesel PM"), each = 3),
  group = rep(c("Norfolk", "Massachussetts", "National"), times = 4),
  value = c(-0.21, 0.18, 0.32, -0.39, 0, -0.04, -0.15, 0.7, 0.09, -0.34, 0.13, 0.37))

pos <- position_dodge(width = 0.65)

ggplot(df, aes(x = value, y = variable, color = group)) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(xmin = 0, xmax = value),
    position = pos,
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = 3),
    position = pos
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#DD5A54", "#608ED8", "#737F2E")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between PM 2.5 and Variables",
    x = "Corr",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Fraunces", size = 14,))

```
